financial.review_sql:
WITH docs AS MATERIALIZED(
SELECT a.document_key,c.anchor_ticker,a.manifest,d.source_fact_count,xmlparse(document population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.financial_shared_body_v1(a.document_key)) body
FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.financial_shared_admission_v1 a JOIN population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.financial_shared_document_v1 d USING(document_key)
JOIN population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.working_accepted_companies_v1 c ON c.company_id='CIK:'||(a.manifest->'filing_ciks'->>0)
WHERE d.normalized_at IS NOT NULL AND c.anchor_ticker NOT IN('AAPL','TXN','UNP','QCOM','AMZN','META','TSLA','V') ORDER BY d.normalized_at,a.document_key LIMIT 32),
nodes AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT d.document_key,d.anchor_ticker,x.* FROM docs d CROSS JOIN LATERAL xmltable(
xmlnamespaces('http://www.xbrl.org/2013/inlineXBRL' AS ix,'http://www.xbrl.org/2008/inlineXBRL' AS ix08,'http://www.xbrl.org/2003/instance' AS x),
'//ix:nonFraction|//ix08:nonFraction|//ix:fraction|//ix08:fraction|/x:xbrl/*[@contextRef]' PASSING d.body
COLUMNS ordinal FOR ORDINALITY,raw_node xml PATH '.',raw_value text PATH 'string(.)',context_id text PATH '@contextRef',unit_id text PATH '@unitRef',decimals text PATH '@decimals',scale text PATH '@scale',sign text PATH '@sign',format text PATH '@format',format_namespace text PATH 'string(namespace::*[name()=substring-before(../@format,":")])',concept text PATH '@name')x),
joined AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT n.*,f.payload,f.record_sha256,regexp_replace(n.raw_value,'[[:space:] ,]','','g') compact
FROM nodes n JOIN population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.financial_shared_fact_v1 f USING(document_key,ordinal)),
checked AS(SELECT *,
payload->>'extraction_state'='PARSED' AND (format IS NULL OR split_part(format,':',2) IN('num-dot-decimal','numdotdecimal')) AND compact~'^-?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([Ee][+-]?[0-9]{1,3})?$' AS numeric_checkable
FROM joined)
SELECT clock_timestamp() checked_at,d.anchor_ticker,d.document_key,encode(sha256(convert_to(d.manifest::text,'UTF8')),'hex') manifest_sha256,
d.source_fact_count,(SELECT count(*) FROM nodes n WHERE n.document_key=d.document_key) actual_source_nodes,
(SELECT count(*) FROM checked n WHERE n.document_key=d.document_key) mapped_facts,
(SELECT count(*) FROM checked n WHERE n.document_key=d.document_key AND (
encode(sha256(convert_to(xmlserialize(CONTENT n.raw_node AS text),'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM n.payload->>'fact_sha256'
OR n.raw_value IS DISTINCT FROM n.payload->>'raw_value' OR n.context_id IS DISTINCT FROM n.payload->>'context_id'
OR n.unit_id IS DISTINCT FROM n.payload->>'unit_id' OR n.decimals IS DISTINCT FROM n.payload->>'source_decimals'
OR nullif(n.format_namespace,'') IS DISTINCT FROM n.payload->>'format_namespace' OR n.sign IS DISTINCT FROM n.payload->>'source_sign' OR n.format IS DISTINCT FROM n.payload->>'source_format'
OR encode(sha256(convert_to(n.payload::text,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM n.record_sha256)) source_copy_errors,
(SELECT count(*) FROM checked n WHERE n.document_key=d.document_key AND numeric_checkable) independently_decoded_numeric_facts,
(SELECT count(*) FROM checked n WHERE n.document_key=d.document_key AND numeric_checkable AND
compact::numeric*power(10::numeric,coalesce(nullif(scale,''),'0')::integer)*CASE WHEN sign='-' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END IS DISTINCT FROM (payload->>'value')::numeric) numeric_errors,
(SELECT count(*) FROM checked n WHERE n.document_key=d.document_key AND NOT coalesce(numeric_checkable,false)) not_independently_decoded,
(SELECT encode(sha256(convert_to(string_agg(record_sha256,E'\n' ORDER BY ordinal),'UTF8')),'hex') FROM checked n WHERE n.document_key=d.document_key) mapped_digest
FROM docs d ORDER BY d.anchor_ticker;
